subject: :art: https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/8554 删除

audit.intent: Delete or Backspace a non-empty cross-block editor selection through one undoable mutation while preserving focus and code rendering.

preconditions: The user invokes Delete, Backspace, or the matching keyboard shortcut from a Protyle editor.
The resolved browser range either spans editable blocks with selected content or targets one or more referenced definition blocks.
stateTransitions: A Zod-backed CaliburRouter partitions non-mutating, cross-block-content, and reference-targeted deletion states before the transaction owner is called.
For a routed mutation, the editor publishes a typed user-operation intent before aborting the prior keydown flow and invoking the shared range-removal transaction.
The shared transaction removes selected ranges in one undoable update, removes empty boundary spans, restores the retained start focus, and invalidates affected code highlighting.
outputs: Delete and Backspace both reach the same cross-block transaction without browser-default partial deletion.
Plugins can observe the user, editor surface, keyboard trigger, operation kind, editor ID, affected block IDs, and reference-target count without receiving selected document content.
invariants: Only a router-confirmed mutation emits an intent event; ignored keyboard states publish nothing.
The public plugin event extends the official siyuan IEventBusMap and contains no internal IProtyle instance.
Existing single-block, image, table, AV, and list deletion branches retain their own established behavior.
failures: A declined reference confirmation leaves the editor DOM unchanged before any transaction is submitted.
A stale or disconnected target is handled by the existing shared removal path rather than applying a partial DOM mutation.

subject: :art: https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/8554 link

audit.intent: Apply one link-menu edit to every link generated by the same inline-mark operation and persist all changed blocks as one undoable transaction.

preconditions: The user opens a Protyle inline link menu for one link or for a caller-supplied group of link elements.
A group spanning multiple blocks supplies the pre-edit HTML for every target block.
stateTransitions: A Zod-backed CaliburRouter partitions the close state into no change, current-block update, and captured multi-block update.
Title and href edits apply to every supplied link element; an all-empty form removes every supplied link element.
A current-block update preserves the established updateTransaction owner; a captured multi-block update emits matched forward and undo operations through one transaction.
outputs: All changed link elements receive the submitted title and href while the existing primary-anchor editing behavior remains unchanged.
Plugins receive content-free user-operation intent events for toolbar link toggles and persisted link-menu updates.
invariants: No unchanged close creates a transaction or emits a link-menu update intent.
A multi-block call without captured baselines, a changed block without an old HTML entry, or a block without data-node-id fails explicitly before a partial persistence transaction.
S-Forge's existing setInlineMark cross-block range normalization is not changed by this series.
failures: Clipboard inspection errors are logged explicitly and the existing selected-text link path continues without fabricating clipboard content.
A missing toolbar range exits before link mutation.

subject: :art: Show backlinks at the bottom of documents https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/18319

audit.intent: 在文档内容末尾提供按需加载的反链与提及面板，并让动态引用、引用计数、事务同步和编辑器生命周期在本地拆分架构中保持与上游一致的可观察行为。

preconditions: 编辑器配置允许显示文档底部反链，且文档编辑器已经完成内容加载并能判定 data-eof=2。
底部面板、固定反链、局部反链和嵌套反链编辑器可能同时存在，调用方必须区分其展示形态和所属根文档。
stateTransitions: Editor 在内容加载完成后创建唯一底部面板，使用 IntersectionObserver 延迟创建 Backlink，使用 MutationObserver 根据 EOF 状态显示或隐藏，并在销毁时先断开观察器、子编辑器和面板 DOM。
反链工具栏和键盘入口通过 CaliburRouter 分派互斥状态；筛选、排序、展开、收起、布局切换和结果操作保留原行为并上报不含文档内容的用户操作意图。
动态引用文本、引用计数、同步事务和重命名通过统一刷新请求按目标范围立即刷新或在索引完成后合并刷新，底部面板离屏时只标记脏状态。
Editor、Wnd、Protyle layout port、删除流程和浮窗副本共享同一嵌套编辑器清理路径；关闭页签或浮窗不得绕过 Editor 生命周期。
outputs: 桌面编辑器在文档底部显示反链/提及工具栏和树列表，语言资源、样式、排序和折叠状态可恢复。
引用计数、动态锚文本、文档同步和删除操作会更新正确的底部或局部面板，不会把不同根文档或嵌套编辑器混淆。
插件可以收到反链工具栏、树操作和键盘操作的结构化意图事件，事件不携带文档正文。
invariants: 固定和局部反链的 WebSocket、历史标题和布局行为保持独立；底部反链不注册布局页签或全局重复连接。
刷新调度状态只存放在 SForgeSymbols 注册表，模块不保留可变计时器；定向刷新只命中目标范围，事务刷新合并为一次延迟索引刷新。
删除、关闭页签、浮窗关闭和初始化失败路径均释放观察器、定时器、嵌套 Protyle、反链面板 DOM 和网络连接。
本周期 app/src 循环依赖基线为 0；所有阶段性出现的环均视为当前候选引入的回归，最终检查必须仍为 0。
failures: 缺少面板元素、配置或布局宿主时按领域守卫显式退出，不创建半初始化反链模型。
过期请求、已销毁面板和离屏面板不会写入当前 DOM；请求失败仍通过现有网络错误链可观察，不伪造成功刷新。
